get.description: Retrieve paginated list of payment transactions.

post.description:
Runs all registered bot scenarios concurrently against all available accounts. Streams each successful payment link as a Server-Sent Event (SSE) as it is generated.

SSE event types:
- started: accounts locked
- payment: link generated
- error: scenario failed
- done: race completed
